queries:
SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_product_quantity,
    (SUM(derived_total_cost) - SUM(derived_product_cost))
        / NULLIF(SUM(derived_product_cost), 0) AS relative_gap
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number

SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_product_quantity,
    (AVG(derived_total_cost) - AVG(derived_product_cost))
        / NULLIF(AVG(derived_product_cost), 0) AS relative_cost_gap
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT
    ili.invoice_number,
    AVG(
        ABS(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL) - ia.avg_quantity)
        / NULLIF(ia.avg_quantity, 0)
    ) AS average_relative_gap
FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
JOIN invoice_averages AS ia
    ON ili.invoice_number = ia.invoice_number
GROUP BY ili.invoice_number

SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_product_quantity,
    (
        SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
                 THEN derived_total_cost END)
        -
        SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
                 THEN derived_product_cost END)
    ) * 1.0
    / NULLIF(
        SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
                 THEN derived_product_cost END),
        0
    ) AS relative_cost_gap
FROM Invoice_Line_Items
GROUP BY invoice_number

WITH line_quantities AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        CAST(product_quantity AS REAL) AS quantity,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY invoice_number
        ) AS average_quantity
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
)
SELECT
    invoice_number,
    average_quantity,
    (quantity - average_quantity) / NULLIF(average_quantity, 0) AS relative_gap
FROM line_quantities
